note: How a control reads a written number (plan section 7.15, AD-31). One golden set for two
src-tauri/resources/scripts/_nc_machine.py (unittest). A disagreement between them is a
Every value below comes from the arithmetic of the declared parameters, not from anyone's
manual: a preset says 'a length without a point is a count of 0.001 mm', and the cases work
out what that makes of X50. The presets themselves are documented defaults of a machine
configuration, never facts about a machine (section 8, section 8.8).
'inputs' are NumberInput objects a machine may carry: a shipped preset is named by
'profile/preset' ('preset', T206) and read from the profile, so the golden set and the
shipped data cannot drift apart; only inputs no profile ships are written out here.
'decls' are machineParams declarations of a built-in profile by id (or written here for
a profile no built-in has), and 'profiles' are the profiles the class rules are read from.
A class case may name 'modes': the modal codes in force outside the cycle and motion groups
(FB-2). A mode that declares an arc-centre word lends the block those words only
(arcCentreEntry / arc_centre_entry), which both sides add to 'inForce' before they ask.
A class case may name 'cycleBlock' (P4h, T118): which block of a two-block cycle of its
'codes' the block is (1 or 2), absent or null when that cannot be told.
